index:fn:getPipelineStats.code: function getPipelineStats(){const leads=data.leads||[];const active=leads.filter(l=>l.status!=='approved'&&l.status!=='lost');const today=_todayISO();const overdueFU=active.filter(l=>l.followUpDate&&l.followUpDate<today).length;const stale=active.filter(isLeadStale).length;const avgDays=active.length?Math.round(active.reduce((s,l)=>s+getLeadStageAgeDays(l),0)/active.length):0;const total=leads.length;const approved=leads.filter(l=>l.status==='approved').length;const lost=leads.filter(l=>l.status==='lost').length;const closed=approved+lost;const winRate=closed>0?Math.round(approved/closed*100):0;return {activeCount:active.length,overdueFU,stale,avgDays,winRate,approved,lost,total};}
